description: KNOWN LIMITATION: 'yeah alex from product team' matches the prefix pattern because 'yeah' is a valid filler and 'alex' follows at the start. The system cannot distinguish 'talking TO the bot' vs 'talking ABOUT someone named Alex' without NLP-level intent detection. This test documents current (expected) behavior.

events.speaker: John
events.text: so we talked to the product team yesterday

events.speaker: Sarah
events.text: yeah alex from the product team said he will handle the integration
events.comment: This WILL trigger because 'yeah alex ...' matches the prefix pattern — known false positive
Documents the false positive — system cannot tell 3rd-person references from bot commands
